# beowulf-fitt-08 — Fitt VIII · Unferth’s Challenge (lines 499–558)

60 lines, Klaeber printed pages 19, 20, 21.

## The lines

```
 499  Unferð maþelode, Ecglāfes bearn,
 500  þē æt fōtum sæt frēan Scyldinga,
 501  onband beadurūne — wæs him Bēowulfes sīð,
 502  mōdges merefaran, micel æfþunca,
 503  forþon þe hē ne ūþe, þæt ǣnig ōðer man
 504  ǣfre mǣrða þon mā middangeardes
 505  gehēde under heofenum þonne hē sylfa —:
 506  ‘Eart þū sē Bēowulf, sē þe wið Brecan wunne,
 507  on sīdne sǣ ymb sund flite,
 508  ðǣr git for wlence wada cunnedon
 509  ond for dolgilpe on dēop wæter
 510  aldrum nēþdon? Nē inc ǣnig mon,
 511  nē lēof nē lāð, belēan mihte
 512  sorhfullne sīð, þā git on sund reôn;
 513  þǣr git ēagorstrēam earmum þehton,
 514  mǣton merestrǣta, mundum brugdon,
 515  glidon ofer gārsecg; geofon ȳþum wēol,
 516  wintrys wylm[um]. Git on wæteres ǣht
 517  seofon niht swuncon; hē þē æt sunde oferflāt,
 518  hæfde māre mægen. Þā hine on morgentīd
 519  on Heaþo-Rǣmas holm ūp ætbær;
 520  ðonon hē gesōhte swǣsne ēþel,
 521  lēof his lēodum, lond Brondinga,
 522  freoðoburh fægere, þǣr hē folc āhte,
 523  burh ond bēagas. Bēot eal wið þē
 524  sunu Bēanstānes sōðe gelǣste.
 525  Ðonne wēne ic tō þē wyrsan geþingea,
 526  ðēah þū heaðorǣsa gehwǣr dohte,
 527  grimre gūðe, gif þū Grendles dearst
 528  nihtlongne fyrst neân bīdan.’
 529  Bēowulf maþelode, bearn Ecgþēowes:
 530  ‘Hwæt, þū worn fela, wine mīn Unferð,
 531  bēore druncen ymb Brecan sprǣce,
 532  sægdest from his sīðe! Sōð ic talige,
 533  þæt ic merestrengo māran āhte,
 534  earfeþo on ȳþum, ðonne ǣnig ōþer man.
 535  Wit þæt gecwǣdon cnihtwesende
 536  ond gebēotedon — wǣron bēgen þā gīt
 537  on geogoðfēore — þæt wit on gārsecg ūt
 538  aldrum nēðdon, ond þæt geæfndon swā.
 539  Hæfdon swurd nacod, þā wit on sund reôn,
 540  heard on handa; wit unc wið hronfixas
 541  werian þōhton. Nō hē wiht fram mē
 542  flōdȳþum feor flēotan meahte,
 543  hraþor on holme, nō ic fram him wolde.
 544  Ðā wit ætsomne on sǣ wǣron
 545  fīf nihta fyrst, oþ þæt unc flōd tōdrāf,
 546  wado weallende, wedera cealdost,
 547  nīpende niht, ond norþanwind
 548  heaðogrim ondhwearf; hrēo wǣron ȳþa.
 549  Wæs merefixa mōd onhrēred;
 550  þǣr mē wið lāðum līcsyrce mīn
 551  heard hondlocen helpe gefremede,
 552  beadohrægl brōden, on brēostum læg
 553  golde gegyrwed. Mē tō grunde tēah
 554  fāh fēondscaða, fæste hæfde
 555  grim on grāpe; hwæþre mē gyfeþe wearð,
 556  þæt ic āglǣcan orde gerǣhte,
 557  hildebille; heaþorǣs fornam
 558  mihtig meredēor þurh mīne hand.
```
